text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Bright? It's not like you to eat lunch this late. Could you wait a few minutes? I'm afraid we can only whip up some ramen at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'd love a serving of that, please. Nothing hits the spot like a savory bowl of ramen after a solo training session. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How strange… No matter how much I eat, my bowl isn't getting any emptier… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Your noodles have gone soggy, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eating all of the soup-heavy noodles proves too much for Bright, who ends up getting a stomachache…
